cues.title: Blue hour
cues.detail: The room settles. One cool wash, no motion.

cues.title: Lanterns
cues.detail: Warm points appear one at a time along the edge.

cues.title: Tide line
cues.detail: A slow band of light moves across and back.

cues.title: Northern arc
cues.detail: Green and violet curves drift overhead.

cues.title: Ember
cues.detail: Everything dims to a low, steady glow.

cues.title: First light
cues.detail: Pale gold rises until the room is plain again.
